name: smart-sprint-planner
title: Smart Sprint Planner
description: Multi-role sprint planning plugin for YouTrack 2024.3+. Supports 9 functional roles with separate composition tables, resources, and history snapshots. Plugin settings live in a dedicated widget with server-side authorization.
changeNotes:
Major upgrade since v2.1.13

🧭 Open from the Main Menu — Sprint planning now lives in YouTrack’s main left-hand menu. A project picker in the header lists the projects you can access where the planner is set up; permissions for settings and actions are still checked per project. The project-settings screen now holds only the planner configuration (roles, permission groups, fields, modes).

🎚️ Compact Tables — Tables across the widget now use tighter typography: reduced line-height and row vertical padding, plus a smaller font for the «Title» column. Long task names no longer stretch rows into tall blocks, so data reads denser while staying legible. Visual only — no logic changes.

🔍 Native YouTrack Search in the Task Picker — The task picker now uses YouTrack's own search: type-ahead suggestions, match highlighting, and the full query syntax (fields, values, IDs, operators) — exactly as in YouTrack itself. Suggestions appear as you type and are scoped to the project; the results list updates when you apply the query (Enter or the search icon). The picker now opens cleanly in place without the page jumping.

🔄 One-Click Refresh from a Task — A single «Refresh from task» button on both planning tabs and the Gantt pulls the full task snapshot (estimate, spent, state, priority, system, assignee) in one batch and updates both tabs and the Gantt at once. Your unsaved edits are protected: when remote values clash with local changes you get a summary with «update all from YouTrack» / «keep my changes» / «show differences». The button now works for the active sprint in any planning status, including once the composition is agreed (it is disabled only for historical snapshots and working copies).

🎨 Native Ring UI, end to end — Every dialog, the settings window, and toast notifications now render with JetBrains Ring UI React components. The plugin looks and feels like a native part of YouTrack.

⚙️ Redesigned Settings — The settings window is now a clean two-pane layout (section list on the left, active section on the right) that scales to every option without clutter.

📊 Task State on the Gantt — Each task shows its current YouTrack state as a coloured badge, the previous state, and how long ago it changed; the timeline bar colour now reflects state.

💬 Polished Modals & Notifications — Consistent focus management, ARIA accessibility, and a clean click-anchored toast notification stack across all 20 dialogs.

🌍 15 UI Languages — Every new label and state badge is fully localized across all 15 supported languages.

🚦 Plan Beyond Limits — A new planning-mode option lets you allow planning with role resource over-allocation: validation is no longer blocked and the over-limit dialog is suppressed, while negative remainders still show in red as an indicator. A status chip in the widget header shows when the mode is on.

⏱️ Clearer Time Entry — Typing a plain number now means hours (e.g. "16" = 16h), the hour/minute suffixes follow your interface language, and every period field auto-formats to a clean hours-and-minutes form right after you type. Day and week shorthand was retired in favour of consistent hours and minutes across input and display.

🐛 Reliability Fixes — The Stand-up tab refresh button now works (it previously sent a malformed request and silently did nothing), the Stand-up view reads assignments from the canonical source so assignees no longer disappear after saving other roles, and the Stand-up buckets no longer show orphan title-less rows for tasks that were removed from the role composition. Plus: single-click checkboxes and row actions in the task picker and grids, working-copy persistence across reload and tabs, a role-items schema fix, role over-allocation now detected from the aggregate even when task estimates are empty, and task Priority/State values now display in the widget's UI language instead of the server locale.

widgets.name: Smart Sprint Planner
widgets.description: Planner settings for the project: functional roles, permission groups (validation / editing / assignee assignment / history clearing), estimate and spent fields, planning modes. Sprint planning itself lives in the main-menu item «Smart Sprint Planner».

widgets.name: Smart Sprint Planner
widgets.description: Sprint planning from YouTrack's main menu: pick an accessible project where the planner is set up, plan sprint composition by role, allocate tasks, review history. Permissions and settings are checked against the selected project.
